decisions.reason: The cited base validators are not the complete checked-out control stack. EVM's profit-guard wrapper requires historical expected edge to cover estimated gas and round-trip costs, while Solana installs historical-return, realised-profit-factor, and loss-quarantine gates. Strategy Lab also already contains a Forecasted Positive Net Edge evaluator requiring positive current executable edge. The proposal is therefore substantially duplicative, and no runtime evidence demonstrates an additional forecast would improve net outcomes.

Code truth confirms SHADOW P&L uses fixed entry and exit fee defaults despite the execution stack modelling additional priority, tip, platform, impact, failure, and refundable-rent components. Recording observed cost components and separately reporting stress imputations is justified without asserting profitability.

Strategy Lab stores aggregate windows and counts execution failures, but lacks trade-level capital duration, incurred failure cost, wallet-delta reconciliation, and mutually exclusive outcome attribution. A SHADOW-only ledger would strengthen evidence quality without changing trading behavior.

The checked-out Strategy Lab can label a promotion candidate from three aggregate windows, eight trades, positive net P&L, and profit factor at least 1.10 without mechanically enforcing a time-split holdout, uncertainty bound, chain separation, or regime coverage. Acceptance is limited to SHADOW promotion-candidate evaluation; the live CANARY state machine is outside the allowed scope and requires separate human review.

The repository already seeds both Liquidity Confirmed Momentum and New Liquidity Quality and implements a cross-chain new-liquidity evaluator with sellability, liquidity, dispersion, freshness, and positive-net-edge gates. The proposed age, price-change, depth, stop, target, fee, and MEV constants have no measured runtime support; Copilot's claimed exploitable mean-reversion window is unsupported and internally mismatched with a momentum entry.
decisions.strategy: New Liquidity Quality and liquidity-confirmed momentum

decisions.reason: Strategy Lab already records eligible opportunities, trades, participation, and signal skips, and evaluate_strategy already returns REWORK_FILTERS when participation is below its configured threshold. Treating low participation as evidence that safety filters should be loosened would risk forced trading; absent opportunity-level outcomes, abstention may be correct.

summary: Architecture-only evidence supports bounded improvements to SHADOW cost accounting, trade-level attribution, and out-of-sample promotion evaluation. No profitability, CANARY, LIVE, increased-frequency, or increased-capital conclusion is supported. Proposed liquidity strategies and participation auditing duplicate checked-in Strategy Lab capabilities, while the proposed copy-entry forecast duplicates existing positive-edge gates and the Forecasted Positive Net Edge evaluator.
